faramir.reason: Lint uses a project-owned snapshot and cache launcher with a literal two-file Docker build context.

tests/container/run.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Host orchestration keeps Docker outside the containers that execute checks.
set -euo pipefail
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd -P)
action=${1:-check}
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then shift; fi
read -r -a tasks <<< "${CHECK_TASKS:-lint test build}"
declare -A declared=()
for category in "${tasks[@]}"; do
  case "$category" in lint|test|build) ;; *) echo 'tests: invalid check category' >&2; exit 2;; esac
  [ -z "${declared[$category]+present}" ] || { echo 'tests: duplicate check category' >&2; exit 2; }
  declared[$category]=1
done
[ "${#tasks[@]}" -gt 0 ] || { echo 'tests: no check categories declared' >&2; exit 2; }
case "$action" in
  info)
    printf '{"version":1,"checks":['
    separator=
    for category in "${tasks[@]}"; do printf '%s"%s"' "$separator" "$category"; separator=,; done
    printf ']}\n'
    exit;;
  check)
    for category in "${tasks[@]}"; do "$0" "$category"; done
    exit;;
  test)
    "$0" e2e
    exec "$0" test-go;;
  build) exec "$root/tests/artifacts.sh" build "${FARAMIR_BUILD_LDFLAGS:--s -w}";;
  e2e)
    for name in faramir-e2e faramir-e2e-rs managed-host managed-host-rs; do
      [ -z "$(docker ps -a --filter "name=^/$name$" --format '{{.Names}}')" ] || {
        echo 'tests: existing E2E stacks are not owned by this check; refusing to replace them' >&2; exit 1
      }
    done
    exec "$root/tests/e2e/e2e.sh" both;;
  test-go)
    "$root/tests/e2e/e2e.sh" fetch
    export CGO_ENABLED=1 FARAMIR_TEST_OUT="$root/bin"
    exec "$root/tests/go/run.sh" bash tests/container/check test-go;;
  lint|shellcheck|command|release|release-check) ;;
  *) echo 'tests: unknown check action' >&2; exit 2;;
esac

scratch=$(mktemp -d)
name=faramir-check-$$
owned=0
trap '
  if [ "$owned" = 1 ]; then docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  find "$scratch" -depth -delete
' EXIT
[ -z "$(docker ps -a --filter "name=^/$name$" --format '{{.Names}}')" ] || {
  echo 'tests: container name already exists' >&2; exit 1
}
revision=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)
source_state=$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)
if [ "$action" = release ] || [ "$action" = release-check ]; then
  [ -z "$source_state" ] || { echo 'tests: publishing checks require clean committed source' >&2; exit 1; }
  [ "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = false ] || {
    echo 'tests: publishing needs reachable release history and version tags' >&2; exit 1
  }
fi
if [ "$action" = release ]; then
  [ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" = true ] && [ "${GITHUB_SHA:-}" = "$revision" ] &&
    [[ "${GITHUB_REF:-}" =~ ^refs/tags/v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] && [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN+x}" ] || {
      echo 'tests: release requires the authorized exact-tag CI publisher' >&2; exit 1
    }
  [ "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse "${GITHUB_REF}^{commit}")" = "$revision" ] || {
    echo 'tests: release tag does not name the source commit' >&2; exit 1
  }
fi
"$root/tests/source.sh" > "$scratch/source.tar"
chmod 0444 "$scratch/source.tar"
digest=$(sha256sum "$scratch/source.tar" | cut -d ' ' -f1)
# shellcheck source=../go/cache.sh
source "$root/tests/go/cache.sh"
node_version=$(go_node_version "$root")
tar -C "$root" -cf - tests/container/Dockerfile tests/container/check \
  tests/container/package.json tests/container/package-lock.json |
  docker build -q -t faramir-check:local --iidfile "$scratch/image.id" \
    --build-arg "NODE_VERSION=${node_version#v}" -f tests/container/Dockerfile - >/dev/null
image=$(cat "$scratch/image.id")
go_cache_mounts
args=(--user 19001:19001 --group-add "$(stat -c %g "$root")" --cpus 4 --memory 4g --pids-limit 512
  --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges
  --mount "type=bind,source=$scratch/source.tar,target=/source.tar,readonly"
  "${GO_CACHE_MOUNTS[@]}" --tmpfs "/work:exec,uid=19001,gid=19001,mode=0700" --tmpfs /tmp:exec
  --env HOME=/tmp --env GOCACHE=/cache/go-build --env GOMODCACHE=/go/pkg/mod
  --env GOTOOLCHAIN=local --env GOMAXPROCS=4 --env GOFLAGS=-p=1 --env CGO_ENABLED=0
  --workdir /work)
# shellcheck disable=SC2016 # The container shell expands its own positional arguments.
program='tar --no-same-owner -xf /source.tar -C /work; exec bash /opt/check/run "$@"'
if [ "$action" = command ]; then export COMMAND; args+=(--env COMMAND); fi
if [ "$action" = release ] || [ "$action" = release-check ]; then
  tags=()
  while IFS= read -r tag; do
    [[ "$tag" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] && tags+=("refs/tags/$tag")
  done < <(git -C "$root" tag --merged "$revision")
  git -C "$root" bundle create "$scratch/release.bundle" HEAD "${tags[@]}"
  chmod 0444 "$scratch/release.bundle"
  args+=(--mount "type=bind,source=$scratch/release.bundle,target=/release.bundle,readonly"
    --env "CHECK_REVISION=$revision" --env "GITHUB_REPOSITORY=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-fixture/project}"
    --env "GITHUB_SERVER_URL=${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}")
  if [ "$action" = release ]; then
    args+=(--env GITHUB_TOKEN --env GITHUB_ACTIONS --env GITHUB_REF --env GITHUB_SHA
      --env "GORELEASER_CURRENT_TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}")
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2016 # These variables belong to the isolated publisher environment.
  program='git clone --quiet --no-checkout /release.bundle /work
    git update-ref --no-deref HEAD "$CHECK_REVISION"
    git read-tree "$CHECK_REVISION"
    tar --no-same-owner -xf /source.tar -C /work
    git ls-files -z | git update-index --skip-worktree -z --stdin
    bash tests/source.sh --list | git update-index --no-skip-worktree -z --stdin
    git remote set-url origin "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY.git"
    test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
    exec bash /opt/check/run "$@"'
fi
docker create --name "$name" "${args[@]}" --entrypoint bash "$image" -euo pipefail -c "$program" _ "$action" >/dev/null
owned=1
status=0
docker start -ai "$name" || status=$?
after=$("$root/tests/source.sh" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f1)
if [ "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)" != "$revision" ] ||
  [ "$(git -C "$root" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" != "$source_state" ] || [ "$after" != "$digest" ]; then
  echo 'tests: source changed during verification; discarding result' >&2
  exit 125
fi
if { [ "$action" = release ] || [ "$action" = release-check ]; } && [ "$status" = 0 ]; then
  [ ! -L "$root/dist" ] || { echo 'tests: release output is a symlink' >&2; exit 1; }
  mkdir -p "$root/dist"
  destination=$(mktemp -d "$root/dist/$action-${revision:0:12}.XXXXXXXX")
  docker cp "$name:/out/dist/." "$destination"
  printf 'release artifacts: %s\n' "$destination"
fi
exit "$status"

tests/container/Dockerfile.content:
ARG NODE_VERSION=24
FROM node:${NODE_VERSION} AS node
WORKDIR /opt/markdown
COPY tests/container/package.json tests/container/package-lock.json ./
# WORKAROUND: Scoped overrides patch CLI dependencies for these advisories.
# https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gg6h-894w-4m9c
# https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7
# Remove the overrides when the upstream CLI resolves patched versions unaided.
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
FROM golang:1.27
COPY --from=node /usr/local/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node
COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm
COPY --from=node /opt/markdown /opt/markdown
ENV PATH="/opt/markdown/node_modules/.bin:${PATH}"
COPY --from=golangci/golangci-lint:v2.15.0 /usr/bin/golangci-lint /usr/local/bin/golangci-lint
COPY --from=koalaman/shellcheck:v0.11.0 /bin/shellcheck /usr/local/bin/shellcheck
COPY --from=goreleaser/goreleaser:v2.20.0 /usr/bin/goreleaser /usr/local/bin/goreleaser
RUN ln -s /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npm \
    && groupadd -g 19001 tester \
    && useradd -u 19001 -g tester -m tester \
    && mkdir -p /out /cache /go/pkg/mod \
    && chown tester:tester /out /cache /go/pkg/mod
COPY tests/container/check /opt/check/run
RUN chmod 0755 /opt/check/run
